title: BotBhai objection handling: the 12 things a Hyderabad salon owner will say (cost, 'my staff answers', trust, data, WhatsApp ban fear...) with honest 2-line answers in Telugu + English
details: Honest answers only; never promise results.
vigil_notes:
FIX:
*   **Row 7 (Support):** "24/7 chat support" is an invented fact not in repo files; replace with "Support via shared inbox and owner alerts" (verified in OFFER.md).
*   **Row 3 (Data):** "All data is encrypted" is an unverified technical claim; remove or mark as UNVERIFIED, keeping only the DPDP processor role (verified).

*   **Row 8 (Website):** "Code snippet" is a technical detail not explicitly in OFFER.md (which only says "website chat"); simplify to "Web chat widget is available" to avoid unverified implementation details.
